description: Defines the QueueId struct, which uniquely identifies a durable queue in Orleans streaming extensions. It includes fields for queue name prefix, numeric ID, and hash, with methods for creation, comparison, and string formatting.

classes.name: QueueId
classes.description: Immutable struct representing a durable queue identifier with comparison and formatting capabilities.

methods.name: GetQueueId
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new QueueId instance.

methods.name: GetStringNamePrefix
methods.description: Returns the queue name prefix string.

methods.name: GetNumericId
methods.description: Returns the numeric ID of the queue.

methods.name: GetUniformHashCode
methods.description: Returns the stored uniform hash code.

methods.name: IsDefault
methods.description: Indicates whether this is the default instance (null name prefix).

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this QueueId to another, based on queueId, name prefix, and hash.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on internal fields.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the QueueId.

methods.name: ToStringWithHashCode
methods.description: Returns string including the hash code.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format QueueId into a span, with optional hexadecimal hash display.
